content_zh:
【脑袋放这里】
陈国。
光元二十八年。
景松城，城外的西郊小树林。
夏天的夜晚，闷热的空气和闪烁的繁星与阵阵的蝉鸣构成了让人难耐的燥热。
树林里或躺、或坐睡、或缩卷着不少人。
这些人穿着破烂肮脏又瘦骨嶙峋。
其中一块大石上躺着一个十岁左右的小孩，小孩似乎没了气息。
然而，就是在这时，小孩瘦弱的胸腔突然又剧烈的起伏，仿佛起死回生一般。
易长生睁开眼睛，气喘吁吁的看了一眼天空，天空点点星光，已经泛白，他转头一脸懵地看向仿佛难民营的小树林。
这，这是哪？
我怎么会在这里？
他下意识地伸手按了一下胸口，倒是不疼了，但嘴巴又干又渴，肚子也饿的慌，仿佛好几天没有吃过饭一样胃里烧得难受。
还没等他搞明白这是怎么一回事，脑中一股记忆浮现。
等吸收了这些记忆，易长生忍不住在心里喊了一声：“靠！”
穿越了。
穿到一个父母双亡，村里又遭洪灾，逃难到县城的一个同名小孩身上。
又是孤儿。
他原本也是孤儿，好不容易大学毕业，进阶996打工人，成为一个游戏小公司里的小码农。
就在昨天，为了加班赶出一个游戏里的天赋，好让玩家充钱抽奖，他熬夜赶工，半夜心脏难受的要命，本想趴在办公桌上眯一会，没想到这一眯就起不来了。

易长生握紧拳头，心中又是懊恼恐慌，又是隐隐的有些期待。
懊恼是早知道就不加班了，不加班他就不会猝死，就不会穿越到这个危险的世界。
从原身的记忆中得知，这个世界不仅有飞檐走壁的武者，还有会飞天遁地的仙人。
而且，每五年就会有仙人到县城检查资质收徒。
上一次仙人来时，原身不到六岁，没到年龄错过了检测资质的时间。
而这次的洪灾，原身也是到达县城后，从不少人的口中听到，洪灾就是因为仙人斗法造成的。
穿到疑似修仙的世界。
易长生深深的吸了一口气，这也是他隐隐期待的地方。
他或许也有机会掌握仙人超凡脱俗的力量，成为高高在上的仙人。
虽然，那些仙人可能会有水份，但依然不是凡人可比。
而且，据传说成为了仙人，只要增长修为，提高境界，确实是可以百病不侵，延年益寿，甚至真的可以长生。
就如他的名字一般，易长生，他也是向往长生的。
虽然这个名字是小时候在孤儿院随机抽取的，但随机抽到这么一个好名字，怎么就不是另一种缘份呢。
不过，这个世界也非常危险。
就好比这次的洪灾，原身连仙人的影子都没看到，就有好几个村子因为他们的斗法受到了牵连。
就这么一点牵连，不知道多少人家流璃失所，妻离子散，家破人亡！
易长生扫了一眼树林里灾民。
content_en:
[Put your head here]
Chen Guo.
Guangyuan twenty-eight years.
Jingsong City, a small forest in the western suburbs outside the city.
On summer nights, the sultry air, twinkling stars and bursts of cicadas create an unbearable heat.
There are many people lying, sitting, sleeping, or curled up in the woods.
The men were dressed in rags, dirty and scrawny.
Lying on one of the big rocks was a child of about ten years old. The child seemed to have lost his breath.
However, at this moment, the child's thin chest rose and fell suddenly and violently, as if he was coming back to life.
Yi Changsheng opened his eyes and panted as he glanced at the sky. The sky was dotted with stars and turned white. He turned his head and looked at the grove that looked like a refugee camp with a confused look on his face.
This, where is this?
Why am I here?
He subconsciously reached out and pressed his chest. It didn't hurt anymore, but his mouth was dry and thirsty, and his stomach was hungry, as if he hadn't eaten for several days and his stomach felt uncomfortable.
Before he could figure out what was going on, a memory came to his mind.
After absorbing these memories, Yi Changsheng couldn't help but shout in his heart: "Fuck!"
Time traveled.
It tells the story of a child with the same name who fled to the county town after his parents died and the village was hit by floods.
Orphan again.
He was originally an orphan. He finally graduated from college and became a 996 worker, becoming a coder in a small gaming company.
Just yesterday, in order to work overtime to get talents in a game so that players could pay for lottery draws, he stayed up late to work. His heart was terribly uncomfortable in the middle of the night. He wanted to lie down on his desk and squint for a while, but he couldn't get up after squinting.
Yi Changsheng clenched his fists, feeling annoyed and panicked, but also vaguely expecting.
The regret is that he would not have worked overtime if he had known better. If he had not worked overtime, he would not have died suddenly and would not have traveled to this dangerous world.
From the memory of the original body, I learned that in this world there are not only warriors who can fly over the walls, but also immortals who can fly into the sky and escape from the earth.
Moreover, every five years, an immortal will come to the county to check the qualifications and recruit disciples.
The last time the immortal came, he was less than six years old, and he missed the time to test his qualifications.
As for the flood this time, after arriving in the county, I heard from many people that the flood was caused by the fighting between immortals.
Travel to a world that is suspected of cultivating immortals.
Yi Changsheng took a deep breath, this was what he was vaguely looking forward to.
He may also have the opportunity to master the otherworldly power of immortals and become a superior immortal.
Although those immortals may have moisture, they are still not comparable to mortals.
Moreover, according to legend, as long as you become an immortal and increase your cultivation and level, you will indeed be immune to all diseases, prolong your life, and even live forever.
Just like his name, Yi Changsheng, he also yearns for immortality.
Although this name was randomly selected in the orphanage when I was a child, how could it not be another kind of fate to randomly select such a good name?
However, this world is also very dangerous.
Just like this flood, the original body didn't even see the shadow of the immortal, but several villages were implicated because of their fighting skills.
With just such a little involvement, countless people have lost their homes, their wives and children, and their families have been destroyed!
Yi Changsheng glanced at the victims in the woods.
